best_hook.why: A sister purring 'I want to see you crawl' is a cruel, scroll-stopping line that promises humiliation.

best_cliffhanger.why: The deadly ultimatum, 'your husband hangs from the gallows', has just been whispered and Juliana has not yet answered.

must_promos.why: Hook on 'crawl', lay out the frozen-thorn bare-hands ordeal and the deal, then cut on the gallows threat before she decides.
Opens on the husband being handcuffed for theft, Juliana fights back and accuses the villains, and it ends on Clarissa naming her price: 'I want to see you crawl.'

standalone_risk: Why the watch was in his coat (planted last episode) and who the magistrate is are not explained; the ordeal itself is only described, not shown.
notes: Mostly dialogue in one room; the threat is strong but the visual payoff comes in the next episode.
